selection_reasoning: These four tasks form a coherent multi-hop benchmark. The scene will be designed so the player must first locate a lilac flower (which marks the path to a forested area), then find tall_seagrass (in a nearby water feature), then mine dark_oak_wood (from dark oak trees near the water), and finally craft a diamond_block at a crafting table placed near the dark oak trees. The dependency chain works as follows: finding the lilac orients the player toward the correct region; finding tall_seagrass confirms they've reached the water area adjacent to the dark oak forest; mining dark_oak_wood requires being in that forest area; and crafting a diamond_block requires having located the crafting station near the dark oak trees (with diamonds pre-placed in a chest nearby). This creates a spatial navigation chain where each discovery leads to the next area.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the lilac flowers (at spawn-relative ~5,0,4-5) and face toward them to confirm visual observation. Target is set to (5, 0, 4) which is one of the two lilac positions. max_distance=8 allows detection from a reasonable range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the flowers.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the tall seagrass in the pond (at spawn-relative ~8,0,8, center of the seagrass cluster) and face toward it. max_distance=10 accounts for the player potentially standing at the pond edge, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking at the seagrass.

Uses inventory_has because mining dark_oak_wood drops the dark_oak_wood item into the player's inventory. The player starts with only diamonds and an iron axe — no dark_oak_wood — so this cannot be pre-satisfied. The player must break at least one dark_oak_wood block from the grove at (~-8,0,6) / (~-7,0,8) / (~-9,0,7).

Uses inventory_has because crafting a diamond_block places it in the player's inventory. The player starts with 9 diamonds (no diamond_block), so this can only be satisfied after using the crafting table at (~-6,0,6) to combine all 9 diamonds into 1 diamond_block.
